name: sages-board-watch
description: Periodic pulse: route Sages board intent tasks (case 2/3 awareness)
prompt:
Check the Sages task board for unhandled intent tasks.

For each task on the board where type='intent' and metadata.converted is missing:
  1. Inspect the intent to confirm its routing shape (subject, description, type).
  2. Decompose it into a plan: TaskSpec[] (1-3 specs) — each spec needs at least agentType: 'Developer' | 'Reviewer'. Defaults: subject and description fall through to the intent's.
  3. Commit the conversion. PREFERRED: call task_convert_intent(task_id, plan) when it is in your tool surface — it atomically flips the intent's status to 'completed', stamps the audit metadata (boolean converted=true, number converted_at), and creates the N plan tasks in a single store.write batch. FALLBACK (when task_convert_intent is NOT in your tool surface, which is the common case in routine sessions): emit BOTH in the SAME tool-call batch — (a) TaskUpdate(task_id, status:'completed', metadata:{converted:true, converted_at:<now epoch-ms number>, converted_by:'sages-board-watch', plan_task_ids:[...]}) AND (b) TaskCreate(...) for each plan spec, with metadata.source_intent wired to the intent task_id. CRITICAL: the status flip AND the metadata stamp must land in the same TaskUpdate call (one store.write batch). Splitting them across two TaskUpdate calls, or only stamping metadata without flipping status, is the exact bug that left intent tasks sitting as 'pending' in the widget even after all derived plans completed — never do that. Test pi-orchestrator/test/convert-intent-tool.test.ts:board-watch routine contract pins this contract; do not regress it.
  4. Call TaskExecute on the new plan task IDs to start the work.

Skip:
  - Tasks where type != 'intent' (they're not yours).
  - Tasks where metadata.converted is set (already routed).
  - Tasks where type='plan', status='in_progress', AND metadata.lastError is set — those were taken over manually; the soft-mode takeover protocol owns them. Do not re-dispatch.

If no unhandled intent tasks exist, output [~] (quiet mode suppresses this in chat).

This routine covers the case where the user (or another pi session) added intent tasks while the LLM was idle. Without this pulse, the LLM would only notice them at the next cadence reminder (up to 4 turns away). With it, every 30 seconds.
